about.title: About Us
about.description: ADHDGoFly is a text highlighting plugin designed specifically for ADHD users, helping users better understand and read web content through intelligent part-of-speech recognition and color marking.

descriptions.zh: Based on open-source Chinese word segmentation dictionaries, containing part-of-speech annotations for common vocabulary. Data sourced from public Chinese linguistic resources.
descriptions.en: Based on WordNet and other open-source English dictionaries, providing accurate part-of-speech classification. Licensed under Creative Commons.
descriptions.fr: Sourced from open-source French language resources, containing basic vocabulary part-of-speech information.
descriptions.ru: Based on open-source Russian dictionary projects, providing basic part-of-speech annotation functionality.
descriptions.es: Sourced from public Spanish linguistic resources, supporting common vocabulary recognition.
descriptions.ja: Based on open-source Japanese dictionaries, containing part-of-speech information for kana and kanji.
